_countMethod: All current database rows. Unique emails are COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(NULLIF(Email, '')))). Address deliverability and marketing consent were not audited. Counts describe captured contacts, not confirmed subscribers or customers.
_conversion: No matched funnel-entry/visitor denominator was found. The existing 14% figure uses 1,750 historical sign-ups / 12,500 followers; it is not a tracked funnel conversion rate. Do not relabel it as one.
_examples: Every display row below is fictional. Only the aggregate totals and field names come from the database. Field completion varies; sample rows do not imply that every contact has location or priority data.
